abstract: We study bounded cross-family composition between (1) moment-free hashed N-gram input lookup tables (Over-Encoding, OE; 603,432 rows across four tables) updated by per-occurrence count division and global table-RMS normalization, and (2) our 0-trainable-parameter backward optimizer (Homotopy BiEq-Muon, warmdown momentum cooldown, right-projected Neumann-Gram vocabulary whitening; +96/+160 MiB FP32 state, +0.042% step FLOPs) plus post-QK-Norm RoPE coordinate scaling. Across 50 complete 499.65M-token (953-step) ClimbMix runs at DEPTH=6 (26.35M backbone + 57.93M OE parameters; 3.2x dense count) and DEPTH=8 (50.33M backbone + 77.24M OE parameters; 2.5x dense count) evaluated on official validation and untouched held-out splits, we execute a matched-schedule 3-seed 2x3 factorial and targeted 3-seed causal interventions. First, conditional on OE, the optimizer improves all three DEPTH=8 seeds from 0.978682 +- 0.000827 to 0.976798 +- 0.001214 held-out BPB (mean delta -0.001884 +- 0.000510, descriptive 95% t-CI [-0.003151, -0.000617]), and the joint package reaches 1.022647 +- 0.001344 held-out BPB at DEPTH=6 (delta -0.001803 +- 0.000670, [-0.003467, -0.000138]; validation CI includes zero) and 0.976057 +- 0.000343 at DEPTH=8 (delta -0.002625 +- 0.000643, [-0.004222, -0.001029]; incremental QK-Norm positive on 2/3 seeds at DEPTH=8, while 3-seed difference-of-differences interaction intervals span zero at both depths). Second, a 3-seed 2x2 causal ablation at DEPTH=6 freezing Layer-0 and high-frequency RoPE (c in [0,15]) query scaling at 1.0 degrades dense joint models by +0.000950 +- 0.000648 held-out BPB (3/3 seeds) but changes OE joint models by only +0.000036 +- 0.000222, while 3-seed Table-Neumann (-0.000081 +- 0.000159 held-out) and BF16-state (-0.002402 +- 0.000733 held-out, +0.0 MiB over OE) replications quantify table-whitening and state-precision tradeoffs.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: Addressed all qualifications from the v1 acceptance review (4Y86P3n2booEn-3e) and expanded the study from 40 to 50 complete 953-step runs across manuscript and paper2_supplement.zip: (1) Shortened the metadata abstract to 244 words and revised abstract, introduction, and conclusions to use 'conditional transfer' / 'composition in the tested cells' rather than 'additive', explicitly stating the zero-spanning 3-seed difference-of-differences interaction intervals, the bounded single-corpus/two-depth/fixed-modulus scope, the 3.2x (d6) and 2.5x (d8) total parameter increase from OE, the uncertain denominators of descriptive retention ratios, and '0-trainable-parameter optimizer (+96/+160 MiB FP32 state, +0.042% step FLOPs)'; (2) Added a 6-run 3-seed 2x2 causal intervention at DEPTH=6 (p2_d6_dense_joint_masked_qk_seed{41,42,47} and p2_d6_mfree_oe_joint_masked_qk_seed{41,42,47}, Section 4.2.2 & Table 5b) that freezes Layer-0 and high-frequency local RoPE (c in [0,15]) query scaling at neutral scale 1.0 while leaving Layers 1..5 and c in [16,63] unrestricted, showing that masking Layer 0 and c in [0,15] degrades dense joint models on all 3 seeds (+0.000923 +- 0.000594 val / +0.000950 +- 0.000648 held-out BPB, erasing 45.9% of the dense QK-Norm gain) while incurring near-zero cost on OE joint models (+0.000011 +- 0.000268 val / +0.000036 +- 0.000222 held-out BPB) and equalizing the remaining deep mid/low-frequency QK-Norm gain (-0.001119 dense vs. -0.001084 OE held-out BPB); and (3) Replicated both the DEPTH=6 Table-Neumann control (p2_d6_mfree_oe_table_neumann_native_seed{41,42,47}: paired delta -0.000005 +- 0.000187 val / -0.000081 +- 0.000159 held-out BPB) and the DEPTH=8 BF16 embedding-state memory/precision control (p2_d8_mfree_oe_joint_bf16state_seed{41,42,47}: 0.976280 +- 0.000315 held-out BPB, delta -0.002402 +- 0.000733 over native OE at +0.0 MiB, trailing FP32-state joint by +0.000223 +- 0.000090 held-out BPB) across all 3 seeds (Seeds 41, 42, 47).
title: Cross-Family Composition and Checkpoint Diagnostics of Moment-Free Hashed N-Gram Input Tables Under Pre-Polar Equilibrated Muon Pretraining
